WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
         event_date as date
        ,session_id
        ,service_line
        ,action
        ,guest_id
        ,label
        ,lower(page_name) as page_name
        ,order_id
	  
    FROM silver_layer.t_link_journey_checkout_com
    WHERE  event_date >= {{start_date}}
	and event_date <= {{end_date}}
	AND   ( 'All' IN ({{natco}}) OR LOWER(natco_code) = {{natco}} )
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(service_line) = lower({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(ui_page_category) = lower({{servie_line}})
        )
        
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{os_naame}})
            OR lower(user_device_type) = lower({{os_naame}})
        )	
        AND lower(category) <> 'addonmanagement'
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{category}})
            OR category = {{category}}
            OR LOWER(category) = {{category}}
        )
		and service_line <> 'NA'
     --  
),
onecheckout AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        service_line,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS onecheckout_initiated
    FROM base
    WHERE page_name LIKE '%basket%'  AND LOWER(action) = 'pageview'
    GROUP BY date, service_line
),
orders AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        service_line,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS order_placed
    FROM base
    WHERE lower(action) in ('onecheckoutinitiated','checkoutSubStepViewed')
    GROUP BY date, service_line
)
SELECT
    o.date,
    o.service_line,
    o.order_placed,
    oc.onecheckout_initiated, 
    ROUND(o.order_placed * 1.0 / NULLIF(oc.onecheckout_initiated, 0), 3) AS conversion_rate
FROM orders o
JOIN onecheckout oc
    ON o.date = oc.date
    AND o.service_line = oc.service_line
ORDER BY o.date, o.service_line;

WITH arraybase AS (
    SELECT
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            TRIM(CAST(uuid AS VARCHAR)),
            '(?i)(attr_items|attr_list|attributelist)$',
            ''
        ) AS item_array_uuid,

        UPPER(TRIM(business_group)) AS business_group,
        LOWER(TRIM(product_category)) AS product_category,
        LOWER(TRIM(name)) AS product_name,
        LOWER(TRIM(item_type)) AS item_type,
        LOWER(TRIM(contract_card_type)) AS contract_card_type,
        LOWER(TRIM(esim_status)) AS esim_status,
        LOWER(TRIM(CAST(ismnpapplied AS VARCHAR))) AS ismnpapplied,
        LOWER(TRIM(product_id)) AS product_id

    FROM eshop_data.es_events_arr_v2

    WHERE DATE(date) BETWEEN {{start_date}} AND {{end_date}}
      AND (
            'All' IN ({{natco}})
            OR LOWER(nc) = LOWER({{natco}})
          )
),

events_base AS (
    SELECT
        DATE(ev.date) AS event_date,
        ev.identifiers_sessionid AS session_id,
        ev.de_ingestion_id AS event_id,

        TRY_CAST(
            REPLACE(
                CAST(ev.identifiers_log_time AS VARCHAR),
                ',',
                ''
            ) AS BIGINT
        ) AS log_time,

        LOWER(TRIM(ev.action)) AS action,
        LOWER(TRIM(ev.identifiers_page_name)) AS page_name,
        LOWER(TRIM(ev.service_line)) AS service_line,
        LOWER(TRIM(ev.category)) AS category,

        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            TRIM(
                CAST(
                    COALESCE(
                        ev.attr_items,
                        ev.attr_list,
                        ev.attributelist
                    ) AS VARCHAR
                )
            ),
            '(?i)(attr_items|attr_list|attributelist)$',
            ''
        ) AS item_array_uuid

    FROM eshop_data.es_events_v2 ev

    WHERE DATE(ev.date) BETWEEN {{start_date}} AND {{end_date}}

      AND ev.identifiers_sessionid IS NOT NULL
      AND ev.identifiers_log_time IS NOT NULL

      AND LOWER(COALESCE(ev.internalemployee, 'no')) = 'no'

      AND (
            'All' IN ({{natco}})
            OR LOWER(ev.nc) = LOWER({{natco}})
          )

      AND (
            'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
            OR LOWER(ev.service_line) = LOWER({{servie_line}})
          )

      AND (
            'All' IN ({{category}})
            OR LOWER(ev.category) = LOWER({{category}})
          )

      AND (
            'All' IN ({{os_naame}})
            OR LOWER(ev.meta_osName) = LOWER({{os_naame}})
          )
),

/*
The first one-checkout-initiated event in the session.
*/
purchase_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        session_id,
        MIN(log_time) AS purchase_time

    FROM events_base

    WHERE action = 'onecheckoutinitiated'

    GROUP BY session_id
),

/*
Join every Basket cart event to all product rows belonging
to the corresponding cart UUID.
*/
cart_events_joined AS (
    SELECT
        ev.event_date,
        ev.session_id,
        ev.event_id,
        ev.log_time,
        ev.action,
        ev.service_line,
        ev.category,

        ps.purchase_time,

        arr.business_group,
        arr.product_category,
        arr.product_name,
        arr.item_type,
        arr.contract_card_type,
        arr.esim_status,
        arr.ismnpapplied,
        arr.product_id

    FROM events_base ev

    LEFT JOIN purchase_sessions ps
        ON ev.session_id = ps.session_id

    LEFT JOIN arraybase arr
        /* UUID-only join because UUID is globally unique */
        ON ev.item_array_uuid = arr.item_array_uuid

    WHERE ev.action IN (
            'addtocart',
            'cart update'
          )

      AND ev.page_name = 'basket'

      /*
      Only cart snapshots before Checkout initiation
      are considered.
      */
      AND (
            ps.purchase_time IS NULL
            OR ev.log_time < ps.purchase_time
          )
),

/*
Create one row per Basket cart event.

All product rows with the same UUID are aggregated here.
*/
event_level AS (
    SELECT
        event_date,
        session_id,
        event_id,
        log_time,
        action,
        service_line,
        category,
        purchase_time,

        /* Main tariff excludes Family Card rows */
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF'
                 AND COALESCE(contract_card_type, '') <> 'familycard'
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS has_main_tariff,

        /* Device flag */
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN business_group = 'MOBILE_DEVICE'
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS has_device,

        /* Plus Card / Family Card flag */
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN contract_card_type = 'familycard'
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS has_plus_card,

        /* Main tariff attributes */
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF'
                 AND COALESCE(contract_card_type, '') <> 'familycard'
                THEN product_id
            END
        ) AS tariff_product_id,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF'
                 AND COALESCE(contract_card_type, '') <> 'familycard'
                THEN product_name
            END
        ) AS tariff_product_name,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF'
                 AND COALESCE(contract_card_type, '') <> 'familycard'
                THEN item_type
            END
        ) AS tariff_item_type,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF'
                 AND COALESCE(contract_card_type, '') <> 'familycard'
                THEN product_category
            END
        ) AS tariff_product_category,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF'
                 AND COALESCE(contract_card_type, '') <> 'familycard'
                THEN esim_status
            END
        ) AS tariff_esim_status,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF'
                 AND COALESCE(contract_card_type, '') <> 'familycard'
                THEN ismnpapplied
            END
        ) AS tariff_ismnpapplied,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF'
                 AND COALESCE(contract_card_type, '') <> 'familycard'
                THEN contract_card_type
            END
        ) AS tariff_contract_card_type,

        /* Plus Card attributes */
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN contract_card_type = 'familycard'
                THEN product_id
            END
        ) AS plus_card_product_id,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN contract_card_type = 'familycard'
                THEN product_name
            END
        ) AS plus_card_product_name,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN contract_card_type = 'familycard'
                THEN product_category
            END
        ) AS plus_card_product_category,

        /* Device attributes */
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN business_group = 'MOBILE_DEVICE'
                THEN product_id
            END
        ) AS device_product_id,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN business_group = 'MOBILE_DEVICE'
                THEN product_name
            END
        ) AS device_product_name,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN business_group = 'MOBILE_DEVICE'
                THEN item_type
            END
        ) AS device_item_type,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN business_group = 'MOBILE_DEVICE'
                THEN product_category
            END
        ) AS device_product_category,

        COUNT(
            CASE
                WHEN business_group IS NOT NULL
                  OR contract_card_type IS NOT NULL
                THEN 1
            END
        ) AS item_count

    FROM cart_events_joined

    GROUP BY
        event_date,
        session_id,
        event_id,
        log_time,
        action,
        service_line,
        category,
        purchase_time
),

/*
Classify every cart event and rank the cart events from
latest to earliest in each session.
*/
latest_cart AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        CASE
            WHEN has_main_tariff = 1
             AND has_device = 1
             AND has_plus_card = 1
                THEN 'Tariff with Device and Plus Card'

            WHEN has_main_tariff = 1
             AND has_device = 0
             AND has_plus_card = 1
                THEN 'Tariff with Plus Card'

            WHEN has_main_tariff = 0
             AND has_device = 1
             AND has_plus_card = 1
                THEN 'Plus Card with Device'

            WHEN has_main_tariff = 0
             AND has_device = 0
             AND has_plus_card = 1
                THEN 'Plus Card Solo'

            WHEN has_main_tariff = 1
             AND has_device = 1
             AND has_plus_card = 0
                THEN 'Tariff with Device'

            WHEN has_main_tariff = 1
             AND has_device = 0
             AND has_plus_card = 0
                THEN 'Tariff Only'

            WHEN has_main_tariff = 0
             AND has_device = 1
             AND has_plus_card = 0
                THEN 'Device Only'

            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS cart_type,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY session_id
            ORDER BY
                log_time DESC,
                event_id DESC
        ) AS rn

    FROM event_level

    WHERE item_count > 0
),

/*
Keep the final cart snapshot in each session.
*/
session_level AS (
    SELECT
        event_date,
        session_id,
        cart_type,

        tariff_product_id,
        tariff_product_name,
        tariff_item_type,
        tariff_product_category,
        tariff_esim_status,
        tariff_ismnpapplied,
        tariff_contract_card_type,

        plus_card_product_id,
        plus_card_product_name,
        plus_card_product_category,

        device_product_id,
        device_product_name,
        device_item_type,
        device_product_category,

        CASE
            WHEN purchase_time IS NOT NULL
             AND purchase_time > log_time
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_converted

    FROM latest_cart

    WHERE rn = 1
      AND cart_type <> 'Other'
)

SELECT
    event_date,
    cart_type,

    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS basket_sessions,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN is_converted = 1
            THEN session_id
        END
    ) AS checkout_initiated_sessions,

    ROUND(
        COUNT(
            DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN is_converted = 1
                THEN session_id
            END
        ) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(
            COUNT(DISTINCT session_id),
            0
        ),
        4
    ) AS conversion_rate

FROM session_level

GROUP BY
    event_date,
    cart_type

ORDER BY
    event_date,

    CASE cart_type
        WHEN 'Tariff Only' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Tariff with Device' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Tariff with Plus Card' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Tariff with Device and Plus Card' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Plus Card Solo' THEN 5
        WHEN 'Plus Card with Device' THEN 6
        WHEN 'Device Only' THEN 7
        ELSE 8
    END;

WITH arraybase AS (

    WHERE date BETWEEN {{start_date}} AND {{end_date}}

        CAST(REPLACE(CAST(ev.identifiers_log_time AS VARCHAR), ',', '') AS BIGINT)  AS log_time,

    FROM eshop_data.es_events_v2 ev

  AND (

  AND (

            OR lower(meta_osName) = lower({{os_naame}})
        )  
)
 
,

purchase_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        session_id,
        MIN(log_time) AS purchase_time
    FROM events_base
    WHERE lower(action) = 'onecheckoutinitiated'
    GROUP BY session_id

cart_events_joined AS (
    SELECT
        ev.date,
        ev.session_id,
        ev.event_id,
        ev.log_time,
        ev.action,
        ev.service_line,
        ev.category,
        ps.purchase_time,
        UPPER(TRIM(arr.business_group))                       AS business_group,
        LOWER(TRIM(arr.product_category))                     AS product_category,
        LOWER(TRIM(arr.name))                                 AS product_name,
        LOWER(TRIM(arr.item_type))                            AS item_type,
        LOWER(TRIM(arr.product_id))                           AS product_id,
        LOWER(TRIM(arr.product_service_line))                 AS product_service_line
    FROM events_base ev
    LEFT JOIN purchase_sessions ps
        ON ev.session_id = ps.session_id
    LEFT JOIN arraybase arr
        ON ev.item_array_uuid = arr.uuid
       AND DATE(ev.date) = DATE(arr.date)
    WHERE ev.action IN ('addtocart', 'cart update')
      AND ev.page_name = 'basket'
      AND (ps.purchase_time IS NULL OR ev.log_time < ps.purchase_time)
),

event_level AS (
    SELECT
        date,
        session_id,
        event_id,
        log_time,
        action,
        service_line,
        category,
        purchase_time,

        -- Fixed tariff (exclude OTT tariffs)
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                           AS has_fixed_tariff,

        -- Device (router, extender, speedport, mesh)
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_group = 'MOBILE_DEVICE'
                  OR product_name LIKE '%router%'
                  OR product_name LIKE '%speedport%'
                  OR product_name LIKE '%extender%'
                  OR product_name LIKE '%repeater%'
                  OR product_name LIKE '%mesh%'
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                           AS has_fixed_device,

        -- OTT plan (TARIFF with tv/ott category, excluding addons)
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF'
                  AND (   product_category LIKE '%tv%'
                       OR product_category LIKE '%ott%'
                       OR product_category LIKE '%streaming%')
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                           AS has_ott_plan,

        -- OTT add-on (addon business group with tv/ott category)
        MAX(CASE WHEN (   business_group = 'AUTOMATIC_ONTOP_ADDONS'
                       OR business_group LIKE '%ADDON%'
                       OR item_type = 'addons')
                  AND (   product_category LIKE '%tv%'
                       OR product_category LIKE '%ott%'
                       OR product_category LIKE '%streaming%')
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                           AS has_ott_addon,

        -- Tariff attributes
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF'
                  AND COALESCE(product_category, '') NOT LIKE '%tv%'
                  AND COALESCE(product_category, '') NOT LIKE '%ott%'
             THEN product_id END)                                         AS tariff_product_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF'
                  AND COALESCE(product_category, '') NOT LIKE '%tv%'
                  AND COALESCE(product_category, '') NOT LIKE '%ott%'
             THEN product_name END)                                       AS tariff_product_name,
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF'
                  AND COALESCE(product_category, '') NOT LIKE '%tv%'
                  AND COALESCE(product_category, '') NOT LIKE '%ott%'
             THEN product_category END)                                   AS tariff_product_category,

        -- Device attributes
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_group = 'MOBILE_DEVICE'
             THEN product_id END)                                         AS device_product_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_group = 'MOBILE_DEVICE'
             THEN product_name END)                                       AS device_product_name,
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_group = 'MOBILE_DEVICE'
             THEN product_category END)                                   AS device_product_category,

        -- OTT plan attributes
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF'
                  AND (   product_category LIKE '%tv%'
                       OR product_category LIKE '%ott%')
             THEN product_id END)                                         AS ott_plan_product_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_group = 'TARIFF'
                  AND (   product_category LIKE '%tv%'
                       OR product_category LIKE '%ott%')
             THEN product_name END)                                       AS ott_plan_product_name,

        -- OTT addon attributes
        MAX(CASE WHEN (   business_group = 'AUTOMATIC_ONTOP_ADDONS'
                       OR item_type = 'addons')
                  AND (   product_category LIKE '%tv%'
                       OR product_category LIKE '%ott%')
             THEN product_id END)                                         AS ott_addon_product_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN (   business_group = 'AUTOMATIC_ONTOP_ADDONS'
                       OR item_type = 'addons')
                  AND (   product_category LIKE '%tv%'
                       OR product_category LIKE '%ott%')
             THEN product_name END)                                       AS ott_addon_product_name,

        COUNT(CASE WHEN business_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)            AS item_count

    FROM cart_events_joined
    GROUP BY date, session_id, event_id, log_time, action,
             service_line, category, purchase_time
),

latest_cart AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN has_fixed_tariff = 1 AND has_fixed_device = 1
             AND has_ott_plan = 1    AND has_ott_addon = 1
                THEN 'Tariff with Device, OTT Plan and OTT Addon'

            WHEN has_fixed_tariff = 1 AND has_fixed_device = 1
             AND has_ott_plan = 1
                THEN 'Tariff with Device and OTT Plan'

            WHEN has_fixed_tariff = 1 AND has_ott_plan = 1
                THEN 'Tariff with OTT Plan'

            WHEN has_fixed_tariff = 1 AND has_fixed_device = 1
                THEN 'Tariff with Device'

            WHEN has_fixed_tariff = 1
                THEN 'Tariff Only'

            WHEN has_fixed_device = 1
                THEN 'Device Only'

            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS cart_type,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY session_id
            ORDER BY log_time DESC, event_id DESC
        ) AS rn

    FROM event_level
    WHERE item_count > 0
),

session_level AS (
    SELECT date,
        session_id,
        cart_type,
        tariff_product_id,
        tariff_product_name,
        tariff_product_category,
        device_product_id,
        device_product_name,
        device_product_category,
        ott_plan_product_id,
        ott_plan_product_name,
        ott_addon_product_id,
        ott_addon_product_name,
        CASE
            WHEN purchase_time IS NOT NULL
             AND purchase_time > log_time
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END AS is_converted
    FROM latest_cart
    WHERE rn = 1
      AND cart_type != 'Other'
)

SELECT date,
    cart_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)                                           AS basket_sessions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_converted = 1 THEN session_id END)       AS purchases,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_converted = 1 THEN session_id END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0), 4
    )                                                                    AS conversion_rate
FROM session_level

ORDER BY
    CASE cart_type

        WHEN 'Tariff with Device' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Tariff with OTT Plan' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Tariff with Device and OTT Plan' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Tariff with Device, OTT Plan and OTT Addon' THEN 5
        WHEN 'Device Only' THEN 6
    END;

        MAX(

        ) AS tariff_ismnpapplied,

            CASE

                 AND COALESCE(contract_card_type, '') <> 'familycard'
                THEN contract_card_type
            END
        ) AS tariff_contract_card_type,

        /* Plus Card attributes */
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN contract_card_type = 'familycard'
                THEN product_id
            END
        ) AS plus_card_product_id,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN contract_card_type = 'familycard'

                THEN 1
            END
        ) AS item_count

    FROM cart_events_joined

    GROUP BY
        event_date,
        session_id,
        event_id,
        log_time,
        action,
        service_line,
        category,
        purchase_time
),

        CAST(REPLACE(CAST(ev.identifiers_log_time AS VARCHAR), ',', '') AS BIGINT)  AS log_time,
        LOWER(TRIM(ev.action))                                                      AS action,
        LOWER(TRIM(ev.identifiers_page_name))                                       AS page_name,

    FROM eshop_data.es_events_v2 ev

	 AND   ( 'All' IN ({{natco}}) OR LOWER(ev.nc) = {{natco}} )
       
	  --AND LOWER(ev.service_line) = 'mobile'
      AND LOWER(ev.internalemployee) = 'no'
      --AND LOWER(ev.service_line) = 'mobile'
      AND (

        )
		AND (

            OR lower(category) = lower({{category}})
        )
  AND (
            'All' IN ({{os_naame}})
            OR lower(meta_osName) = lower({{os_naame}})
        )
	  
)
,

purchase_sessions AS (
    SELECT session_id, MIN(log_time) AS purchase_time
    FROM events_base
    WHERE  lower(action) in ('onecheckoutinitiated','checkoutSubStepViewed')
    GROUP BY session_id
),

event_level AS (
    SELECT
        ev.date,
        ev.session_id,
        ev.event_id,
        ev.log_time,
        ev.service_line,
        ps.purchase_time,

        MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(arr.business_group)) = 'TARIFF'         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_tariff,
        MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(arr.business_group)) = 'MOBILE_DEVICE'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_device,
        MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(arr.contract_card_type)) = 'familycard' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_plus_card,

        -- Main card tariff (primary line)
        MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(arr.business_group)) = 'TARIFF'
                  AND LOWER(TRIM(arr.contract_card_type)) = 'maincard'
             THEN LOWER(TRIM(arr.name)) END)                                       AS main_tariff_name,

        -- Fallback for sessions without maincard tag
        MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(arr.business_group)) = 'TARIFF'
             THEN LOWER(TRIM(arr.name)) END)                                       AS any_tariff_name,

        MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(arr.business_group)) = 'TARIFF'
             THEN LOWER(TRIM(arr.product_id)) END)                                 AS tariff_product_id,

        COUNT(CASE WHEN arr.business_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)                 AS item_count

    FROM events_base ev
    LEFT JOIN purchase_sessions ps ON ev.session_id = ps.session_id
    LEFT JOIN arraybase arr
        ON ev.item_array_uuid = arr.uuid
       AND DATE(ev.date) = DATE(arr.date)
    WHERE ev.action IN ('addtocart', 'cart update')
      AND ev.page_name = 'basket'
      AND (ps.purchase_time IS NULL OR ev.log_time < ps.purchase_time)
    GROUP BY ev.date, ev.session_id, ev.event_id, ev.log_time, ev.service_line, ps.purchase_time
),

session_level AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(main_tariff_name, any_tariff_name) AS tariff_name,

        -- Tariff tier extraction (XL checked before L)
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(main_tariff_name, any_tariff_name) LIKE '%xl%'  THEN 'XL'
            WHEN COALESCE(main_tariff_name, any_tariff_name) LIKE '% l'
              OR COALESCE(main_tariff_name, any_tariff_name) LIKE '% l %' THEN 'L'
            WHEN COALESCE(main_tariff_name, any_tariff_name) LIKE '% m'
              OR COALESCE(main_tariff_name, any_tariff_name) LIKE '% m %' THEN 'M'
            WHEN COALESCE(main_tariff_name, any_tariff_name) LIKE '% s'
              OR COALESCE(main_tariff_name, any_tariff_name) LIKE '% s %' THEN 'S'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS tariff_tier,

        -- Tariff family (Magenta Mobil vs Magenta Home vs other)
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(main_tariff_name, any_tariff_name) LIKE '%magenta mobil%'   THEN 'Magenta Mobil'
            WHEN COALESCE(main_tariff_name, any_tariff_name) LIKE '%magentamobil%'    THEN 'Magenta Mobil'
            WHEN COALESCE(main_tariff_name, any_tariff_name) LIKE '%magenta home%'    THEN 'Magenta Home'
            WHEN COALESCE(main_tariff_name, any_tariff_name) LIKE '%magentahome%'     THEN 'Magenta Home'
            WHEN COALESCE(main_tariff_name, any_tariff_name) LIKE '%magenta%'         THEN 'Magenta Other'
            ELSE 'Other Tariff'
        END AS tariff_family,

        CASE
            WHEN has_tariff = 1 AND has_device = 1 AND has_plus_card = 1
                THEN 'Tariff with Device and Plus Card'
            WHEN has_tariff = 1 AND has_plus_card = 1
                THEN 'Tariff with Plus Card'
            WHEN has_tariff = 1 AND has_device = 1
                THEN 'Tariff with Device'
            WHEN has_tariff = 1
                THEN 'Tariff Only'
            WHEN has_device = 1
                THEN 'Device Only'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS cart_type,

        CASE
            WHEN purchase_time IS NOT NULL AND purchase_time > log_time
                THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END AS is_converted,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY session_id
            ORDER BY log_time DESC, event_id DESC
        ) AS rn

    FROM event_level
    WHERE item_count > 0
)

-- View 1: Conversion by tariff tier (M vs L vs XL), split by service line
SELECT
    service_line,
    tariff_name,
    tariff_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)                                       AS basket_sessions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_converted = 1 THEN session_id END)   AS purchases,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_converted = 1 THEN session_id END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0), 4
    )                                                                AS conversion_rate
FROM session_level
WHERE rn = 1
  AND cart_type != 'Other'
  AND has_tariff = 1
  AND tariff_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) >= 20
ORDER BY service_line, basket_sessions DESC;

        -- Tier extraction (XL before L to avoid mismatch)
        CASE
            WHEN tariff_name LIKE '%xl%'  THEN 'XL'
            WHEN tariff_name LIKE '% l '
              OR tariff_name LIKE '% l'
              OR tariff_name LIKE '%_l_%'
              OR tariff_name LIKE '% l%flex%' THEN 'L'
            WHEN tariff_name LIKE '% m '
              OR tariff_name LIKE '% m'
              OR tariff_name LIKE '%_m_%'
              OR tariff_name LIKE '% m%flex%' THEN 'M'

              OR tariff_name LIKE '% s'
              OR tariff_name LIKE '%_s_%'
              OR tariff_name LIKE '% s%flex%' THEN 'S'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS tariff_tier,

        -- Flex flag
        CASE
            WHEN tariff_name LIKE '%flex%' THEN 'Flex'
            ELSE 'Standard'
        END AS tariff_variant,

             THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No'
        END AS tariff_changed,

        -- Did tier change?
        CASE WHEN f.tariff_tier != l.tariff_tier
             THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No'
        END AS tier_changed,

             THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No'

            WHEN f.tariff_variant = 'Flex' AND l.tariff_variant = 'Standard'

            WHEN f.tariff_variant = 'Flex' AND l.tariff_variant = 'Flex'

            WHEN f.tariff_variant = 'Standard' AND l.tariff_variant = 'Standard'

            WHEN f.tariff_tier = l.tariff_tier

            WHEN f.tariff_tier != l.tariff_tier

              AND (
                    (f.tariff_tier = 'S' AND l.tariff_tier IN ('M','L','XL'))
                    OR (f.tariff_tier = 'M' AND l.tariff_tier IN ('L','XL'))
                    OR (f.tariff_tier = 'L' AND l.tariff_tier = 'XL')

                    OR (f.tariff_tier = 'M' AND l.tariff_tier IN ('L','XL'))
                    OR (f.tariff_tier = 'L' AND l.tariff_tier = 'XL')
                  )
                THEN 'Tier Upgrade + Dropped Flex'
            WHEN f.tariff_tier != l.tariff_tier
              AND f.tariff_variant = l.tariff_variant
              AND (
                    (f.tariff_tier = 'S' AND l.tariff_tier IN ('M','L','XL'))
                    OR (f.tariff_tier = 'M' AND l.tariff_tier IN ('L','XL'))
                    OR (f.tariff_tier = 'L' AND l.tariff_tier = 'XL')
                  )
                THEN 'Tier Upgrade → Same Variant'

            -- Tier downgrade with flex change
            WHEN f.tariff_tier != l.tariff_tier
              AND f.tariff_variant = 'Standard' AND l.tariff_variant = 'Flex'
              AND (
                    (f.tariff_tier = 'XL' AND l.tariff_tier IN ('L','M','S'))
                    OR (f.tariff_tier = 'L' AND l.tariff_tier IN ('M','S'))
                    OR (f.tariff_tier = 'M' AND l.tariff_tier = 'S')

    JOIN tariff_classified l ON stc.session_id = l.session_id AND l.rn_last = 1

            WHEN f.tariff_tier = l.tariff_tier

                THEN 'Tier Upgrade → Same Variant'

            -- Tier downgrade with flex change
            WHEN f.tariff_tier != l.tariff_tier
              AND f.tariff_variant = 'Standard' AND l.tariff_variant = 'Flex'
              AND (
                    (f.tariff_tier = 'XL' AND l.tariff_tier IN ('L','M','S'))
                    OR (f.tariff_tier = 'L' AND l.tariff_tier IN ('M','S'))
                    OR (f.tariff_tier = 'M' AND l.tariff_tier = 'S')

    FROM session_tariff_count stc

    JOIN tariff_classified l ON stc.session_id = l.session_id AND l.rn_last = 1

      AND LOWER(ev.service_line) = 'mobile'
      AND LOWER(ev.category) = 'acquisition'
),

basket_tariffs AS (
    SELECT
        ev.session_id,
        ev.event_id,
        ev.log_time,
        LOWER(TRIM(arr.product_id))  AS tariff_product_id,
        LOWER(TRIM(arr.name))        AS tariff_name
    FROM events_base ev
    LEFT JOIN arraybase arr
        ON ev.item_array_uuid = arr.uuid
       AND DATE(ev.date) = DATE(arr.date)
    WHERE ev.action IN ('addtocart', 'cart update')
      AND ev.page_name = 'basket'
      AND UPPER(TRIM(arr.business_group)) = 'TARIFF'
      AND (

),

tariff_classified AS (
    SELECT

        tariff_product_id,
        tariff_name,
        CASE
            WHEN tariff_name LIKE '%xl%'             THEN 'XL'
            WHEN tariff_name LIKE '% l '
              OR tariff_name LIKE '% l'
              OR tariff_name LIKE '%_l_%'            THEN 'L'
            WHEN tariff_name LIKE '% m '
              OR tariff_name LIKE '% m'
              OR tariff_name LIKE '%_m_%'            THEN 'M'
            WHEN tariff_name LIKE '% s '
              OR tariff_name LIKE '% s'
              OR tariff_name LIKE '%_s_%'            THEN 'S'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS tariff_tier,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY session_id
            ORDER BY log_time ASC, event_id ASC
        ) AS rn_first,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY session_id
            ORDER BY log_time DESC, event_id DESC
        ) AS rn_last

),

session_level AS (

        f.session_id,

        l.tariff_name       AS last_tariff_name,
        l.tariff_tier       AS last_tariff_tier,
        l.tariff_product_id AS last_tariff_id,

        -- Simple: changed or not
        CASE
            WHEN f.tariff_product_id = l.tariff_product_id
                THEN 'No Change'
            ELSE 'Changed'
        END AS tariff_changed,

        -- If changed: upgrade, downgrade, or lateral
        CASE
            WHEN f.tariff_product_id = l.tariff_product_id
                THEN 'No Change'
            WHEN (f.tariff_tier = 'S' AND l.tariff_tier IN ('M','L','XL'))
              OR (f.tariff_tier = 'M' AND l.tariff_tier IN ('L','XL'))
              OR (f.tariff_tier = 'L' AND l.tariff_tier = 'XL')

            WHEN (f.tariff_tier = 'XL' AND l.tariff_tier IN ('L','M','S'))

    WHERE f.rn_first = 1
      AND l.rn_last = 1
)

SELECT

    SUM(CASE WHEN nps_category = 'promoter'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promoters,
